candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics; 503 origin (overload, crash, config) unconfirmed. Inventory/redis path succeeded.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent 503 from payment /v1/authorizations propagating to order 502 and gateway checkout 502; inventory reservations succeed. Root cause localized to payment service erroring, but underlying payment fault not yet evidenced.
